metadata.case_name: CHOW PO v. CHOW HAU MAN R/A NICE YEAR METAL CO

injuries.body_part: right distal tibia / right lower leg
source: The Plaintiff’s right leg was cut (the cut wound being 5cm long) and crashed seriously. His right distal tibia was fractured.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower end of tibia

source: The Plaintiff’s right leg was cut (the cut wound being 5cm long) and crashed seriously. His right distal tibia was fractured.

injuries.description: Multiple surgical scars on right leg
source: His right leg has multiple surgical scars.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

manifestations.description: He feels pain and weak for prolonged standing or walking.
He is not able to carry heavy objects.

treatments_received: 3 surgical operations (2 major orthopaedic reconstructive surgeries)
Intramedullary nail and 4 cross locking screws affixed to the bone
Medical expenses conceded $3,550; travelling expenses conceded $5,270; tonic food allowed $3,000

losses.description: He feels pain and weak for prolonged standing or walking; impaired ability to handle heavy lifting and prolonged walking; inability to carry heavy objects; walking with a limp. Dr. Poon observed that his ability to handle heavy lifting and prolonged walking is definitely impaired to some degree.
Multiple surgical scars on right leg.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chong Yiu Tat v. Fong Man Chi
comparable_cases.injury_description: Fracture of his distal tibia involving the ankle joint. After surgery and rehabilitation he recovered with residual pain and stiffness, with a chance of degenerative authorities. He could not return to his pre-injury job of installing air-conditioners at construction sites. He can only do light duty jobs.
